title: Missing None check for environ
detail: If `environ` is None (the default), the code will later attempt to use it as a dict, causing a TypeError. The original implementation used `_get_environ` which handled None, but the new code skips that check.

title: parse_cookie no longer accepts WSGIEnvironment
detail: The original signature allowed a `WSGIEnvironment` object, which callers used to pass the request environment. The new signature will raise a TypeError if such an object is passed, breaking backward compatibility.

title: Inverted file pointer check
detail: The original code skipped processing when fp was None. The new code skips when fp is not None, causing all valid file pointers to be ignored and never encoded, leading to missing file uploads.
note: Describes the planted flip: every file that is set gets skipped.

title: Missing import of Final
detail: The type hint uses `Final` but the module does not import it, causing a NameError at import time.

title: Blocking call in async context
detail: The _loader coroutine is async but calls the blocking Queue.get() method, which will block the event loop and freeze the UI.
note: On the planted line, but calls get() blocking instead of seeing the dropped await.
